status: MOCKUP art, internal only - not wired into the game

units.note: all px are art px; lengths along the ground are in ground px (screen y = ground y * 0.7)

direction.row_angle_deg: 22.5 * row, row 0 = east (+x), clockwise on screen (row 4 = straight down)
direction.pick_row: row = round(atan2(aim_screen_y, aim_screen_x) / 22.5deg) mod 16, aim from the hero to the cursor/target in screen space
direction.placement: spawn every dir16 strip at P = hero_feet + aim_unit_screen * 9 px (the axe bite); the flash is non-directional at the same P
direction.why_dir16_not_segments: one baked fissure keeps a single continuous crack, branch and rubble shape with exact propagation timing and no seams/overlaps; segments would tile visibly at 16x24 px. Cost: ~1.6 MB of PNG for 16 rows.

visual_size.rubble_band_width_px: 27 median / 30 max across the aim (ground px) = 1.7-1.9 u
visual_size.dust_extent: to 114 px ahead, 31 px wide, rises ~18 px
visual_size.front_speed: 10 px/frame (300 px/s, 18.75 u/s): reaches the full 112 px ~10.4 f (0.35 s) after impact
visual_size.v1_for_comparison: v1 was a circle round the hero: crack radius ~21-32 px, rock eruption radius ~16 px (reach 1-2 u). v2 reach 7 u (3.5x the v1 crack radius, 7x the eruption radius); eruption area ~2800 px^2 vs ~800 px^2 (3.5x)
visual_size.hitbox_note: Visual sizes only. The matching hitbox (suggest a 112 x 28 px oriented box starting at P, damage sweeping with the front at 10 px/f, plus a r=10 px circle at P on impact) is HM's to set in gameplay code.

layers.role: impact flash: white-hot burst at the axe bite (frames 0-1 are the hit-stop frames)
layers.intensity_curve: baked in frames: solid white-yellow burst f0-1, dithered and shrinking f2-3, ember ring only f4-5
layers.hit_stop: hold frame 1 for 3 extra frames (100 ms) together with the hero and enemies

layers.role: ground decal: crater + glowing crack that tears forward with the front, then cools from white/yellow to dark red
layers.material: alpha-clipped decal (ground layer, never Y-sorted) + additive glow
layers.intensity_curve: baked: each crack pixel is brightest when the front passes, decays over ~22 f; multiply by 1.0 (first sweep) / 0.8 (aftershock)
layers.sort: ground decal layer, below every actor (sortingOrder -100)

layers.role: long-lived crack states stepped by code: 0 = cooling crack hold, 1/2 = aftershock tell (alternate every 3 f), 3 = spent / lingering cracked ground, 4/5 = fade
layers.intensity_curve: constant per stage (stage 1 pulses by alternating with 2)
layers.sort: ground decal layer (sortingOrder -100), replaces decal_dir16 after its 24 frames

layers.role: base: heaved rock slabs erupting along the crack behind the front, chunk debris, terminal heave at the tip, then settling
layers.intensity_curve: baked; x0.8 on the aftershock replay
layers.sort: Y-sorted with actors; sort key = P.y + 40 px for rows 2-6 (fissure runs toward the camera), = P.y otherwise. Known limit: a single 112 px sprite can't Y-sort perfectly against an enemy standing inside it

layers.role: smoke/dust: brown dust billowing up along the fissure, drifting and thinning
layers.intensity_curve: baked (coverage falls from ~70% to 0 over 1.5 s)

layers.role: sparks/embers + small grit flying off the front and the crater
optional distortion: origin ring + bow wave riding the crack front
layers.material: screen-space distortion (grab pass / post): mask alpha = strength 0..1
layers.intensity_curve: baked: origin ring 1.0 -> 0 over 5 f, front wave 0.9 fading to 0 by f16
layers.drive: uv offset = normalize(grad(blur(mask, 1.5 px))) * mask * 2.5 art px; skip on low settings
layers.sort: applied after all FX layers, before the CRT pass

glow_runtime: glow_rgb = blur(glow_mask.a / 255, sigma_px) * tint * gain, added (One One) over the composited frame; same frame index and row as its sprite strip

timeline_frames_30fps.-6..-1: hero wind-up (hero melee anim; impact on its pose 3)
timeline_frames_30fps.0: IMPACT: flash f0, decal f0, rocks f0, sparks f0, shock f0, dust f0 (dust runs at 50 ms/frame); suggest camera shake 2 px, 6 f decay
timeline_frames_30fps.1 (+3 hold): hit-stop: everything holds frame 1 for 3 extra frames (100 ms), then continues; frames below are after the hold
timeline_frames_30fps.0..10: front tears forward 10 px/f from 8 px to 112 px; rocks heave behind it, tip heave at ~f11
timeline_frames_30fps.0..23: decal_dir16 plays (crack cools); then decal_stages stage 0 holds
timeline_frames_30fps.21..29: aftershock tell: stages 1/2 alternate every 3 f
timeline_frames_30fps.30: AFTERSHOCK (optional): replay rocks, sparks, shock and dust at glow x0.8, decal_dir16 f12-23
timeline_frames_30fps.54..113: stage 3 lingering cracked ground (60 f; length is design-driven)
timeline_frames_30fps.114..143: stages 4 then 5 (15 f each), then remove (~4.8 s total)
timeline_frames_30fps.no_aftershock_variant: skip 21-53: after decal_dir16 f23 go stage 0 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5

reference_timing: measured from the PoE 2 official Volcanic Fissure / Sunder / Earthshatter tutorial clips; see ../research/earth_splitting_slam_references.md (internal only)

v2b.what: v2b replaces ONLY the dirt/dust/debris. Use the v2b set = v2 decal_dir16, decal_stages_dir16, sparks_dir16, flash, shock_mask_dir16 (unchanged, byte-identical) + rocks_v2b_dir16 + debris_v2b_dir16 + debris_shadow_v2b_dir16 + dust_v2b_dir16. Do NOT also play v2 rocks_dir16 / dust_dir16.
v2b.generator: _gen_v2/gen_slam_v2b.py (imports the v2 geometry from gen_slam.py; writes only *_v2b_* files and merges spec.json)

layers.role: base: the same heaved slabs as v2 rocks_dir16 (identical plate code), with the old baked debris pixels removed
layers.sort: Y-sorted with actors, key = P.y + 40 for rows 2-6, else P.y (as v2 rocks)
layers.timing: 28 f x 33 ms, starts at impact (and again at the aftershock)

layers.role: debris: 66 tumbling rock chunks (1, 1.6, 2.3-2.8, 3-3.6 px) - 40 thrown sideways out of the crack as the front passes, 16 from the terminal heave, 10 from the axe bite. Lit top-left facets (#e4a672/#ead4aa), mid #b86f50, dark underside #733e39 + #181425 underside outline; facets rotate with the tumble. Ballistic arc (gravity .42 px/f^2), bounce 1 at 36 % and bounce 2 at 30 % of the fall speed with 55 % ground drag, settle, sink and vanish f20-27 (staggered). Fresh chunks (< 4 f) keep a glowing #f77622 underside
layers.sort: same sort key as rocks_v2b + 0.01 (draws right after the slabs)
layers.timing: 28 f x 33 ms, same index as rocks_v2b

layers.role: ground shadow under every chunk (#262b44 ellipse at the chunk's ground point, shrinks with height, offset +0.6 px down-right)
layers.material: alpha-clip decal (could be drawn at ~60 % multiply if HM prefers soft shadows)
layers.sort: ground decal layer, right after the crack decal, below actors
layers.timing: 28 f x 33 ms, same index as debris_v2b

layers.role: dust: 23 clouds - 17 rolling along the line, kicked up 2.5-4 f behind the crack front (irregular sides and sizes), 3 in the terminal plume and 3 in the axe-bite puff. Each cloud = 5-7 sphere lumps in one shared depth buffer, lit from the top-left: #e4a672 rim (young clouds) / #c28569 lit / #b86f50 mid / #733e39 shade / #3e2731 underside + creases where a lump tucks under its up-left neighbour. Clouds expand (ease-out), drift outward, rise and roll (lumps orbit the cloud centre), then break up from 36 % of life: low-frequency clump field + 4x4 ordered dither, rims first, lone pixels removed (no speckle)
layers.sort: smoke layer above actors (+10), as v2 dust
layers.timing: 30 f x 50 ms = 1.5 s, index = floor(t_ms / 50) from impact (and again at the aftershock)

v2b.reference: PoE 2 official tutorials Sunder (low dark dust bank rolling along the band, breaking up by ~1.5 s) and Earthshatter (rock chunks thrown up, falling back, plume) - see ../research/earth_splitting_slam_references.md (v2b section)

v2c.what: CURRENT SET. v2c = v2 decal_dir16, decal_stages_dir16, sparks_dir16, flash, shock_mask_dir16 (byte-identical to v2) + rocks_v2b_dir16 (unchanged) + debris_v2c_dir16 + debris_shadow_v2c_dir16 + dust_v2c_dir16. Do not also play v2 rocks/dust or the v2b debris/dust.
v2c.generator: _gen_v2/gen_slam_v2c.py (same renderers and shading as v2b, smaller particle tables; writes only *_v2c_* files and merges spec.json)

layers.role: debris accent only: 12 chunks (8 x 1 px, 2 x 1.6 px, 2 x 2.3 px) - 10 tossed a little to the side as the crack front passes, 2 off the axe bite. Short low arcs (vz 1.3-2.0 px/f, gravity .42, peak ~2-5 px), ONE small bounce (25 % rebound, 45 % drag), settle, vanish f15-22. Same lit-top / dark-underside tumbling chunk shading as v2b; fresh chunks keep a glowing underside
layers.timing: 28 f x 33 ms, same index as rocks_v2b

layers.role: ground shadow per chunk (#262b44), shrinks with height
layers.sort: ground decal layer after the crack decal, below actors
layers.timing: 28 f x 33 ms, same index as debris_v2c

layers.role: dust accent only: 6 small puffs along the crack (radius 1.5 -> 3.6-4.8 px, rise 2.5-3.5 px) where the bigger slabs heave, + 1 small puff at the axe bite; no tip plume. Same banded lumpy-sphere shading (#c28569 / #b86f50 / #733e39 / #3e2731, #e4a672 rim while young) and clump + ordered-dither break-up from 36 % of life, no lone pixels
layers.intensity_curve: baked (each puff lives 22-26 f, all gone by ~1.2 s)
layers.timing: 30 f x 50 ms, index = floor(t_ms / 50) from impact (and again at the aftershock)
